title: Flurry of Diplomacy in Iran Amid Reports of U.S. and Israeli Plans to Renew War
summary_full: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan made a rare joint visit to Tehran amid reports that the U.S. and Israel were drawing up plans to renew their attacks on Iran.
